component.name: Recurra
component.summary: Privacy-first offline subscription, recurring bill, and warranty tracker

description.p: Recurra is a free, open-source, 100% offline-first application for tracking subscriptions, recurring bills, free trials, and product warranties across Linux, Windows, and Android.

Features include normalized monthly and yearly spend dashboards, multi-currency offline conversion, a renewal calendar, 12-month cashflow projections, AES-256-GCM encrypted backups, and RFC-4180 CSV export and import.
Universal Linux distro polish: Wayland/Hyprland launcher fixes, RPM & Arch PKGBUILD packaging, AppStream metadata, native desktop window icon, and Linux notify-send renewal alerts.
